title: GTA 6 Cars Appear in Real Life as Part of Insane Miami Marketing Push
text: GTA 6 Cars Appear in Real Life as Part of Insane Miami Marketing Push | Push Square Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Push Square News Reviews Features Videos Games PS Plus Guides Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 GTA GTA 6 Cars Appear in Real Life as Part of Insane Miami Marketing Push Vice City is real now by Stephen Tailby 8 hours ago Share: It was obvious already, but with an outrageous marketing push behind it, GTA 6 is clearly going to be absolutely massive when it arrives next month. The hotly anticipated open world action game is scheduled for 19th November, 2026, and Rockstar Games and parent company Take-Two are going all-out with a marketing campaign that's overtaking Miami, Florida, gradually turning it into a real-life Vice City. We've already heard about a one-night-only basketball match, in which the team Miami Heat will be rebranded as Vice City , playing against Milwaukee in a special promotional game. That's already crazy enough, but now, GTA 6 is spreading throughout Miami in other ways. The maddest I've seen so far is several cars from the games are now driving around the city. Vice City-themed vehicles have been spotted in Miami, including a Lamborghini in Vice Beach PD livery. The Leonida plates match those seen in the earlier Suzuki tease. #GTAVI 📸 @/gianni_mariotti & @/andrewblakeames (Instagram) pic.twitter.com/hZVGzjPNaF - iGrandTheftAuto.com (@iGrandTheftAuto) October 16, 2026 In the above videos, numerous real life vehicles have been kitted out to look like cars from GTA 6, with Vice City number plates and colourful body kits. Among them are police cars from the Vice Beach Police Department. On top of that, clips seen on Instagram show Vice City branding being installed, a blimp bearing the logo, and planes flying promotional banners. GTA was in full effect today 😤 #ONLYinDADE pic.twitter.com/9twnQHQ7ET - ONLY in DADE (@ONLYinDADE) October 15, 2026 None of these things explicitly mention GTA 6 itself, but there's already a lot of awareness for the game, and all these marketing stunts are perfect for going viral on socials, which will definitely be part of the goal.
